# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is the course handbook for the **Extracellular Electrophysiology** course
taught at the [Neuroinformatics Unit Open Software Summer
School](https://neuroinformatics.dev/open-software-summer-school/index.html) (2026).

It walks through the theory and implementation of a full spike-sorting pipeline
with [SpikeInterface](https://spikeinterface.readthedocs.io/), from preprocessing and sorting through to analysis.

## Get started

To work through the course, follow the [setup instructions](setup.qmd). You can complete the entire course in order, or start from any self-contained chapter. The best way to
work through the course is to read through the coding chapters, and copy the relevant code (by hand!) to apply the steps in your own Python environment.

We provide small test datasets to use throughout the course (see [course
data](course-data.qmd)), but you can equally apply the material to your own data.

You may also be interested in the [glossary](glossary.qmd) and [concept
notes](concept-notes.qmd), which describe the terminology and key concepts in
extracellular electrophysiology.
